list.name: country
list.label: Country
list.query: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '__all' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country_code AS __text, country_code AS __value FROM europe_jobs ORDER BY country_code)
list.definition: SELECT 'All' AS __text, '__all' AS __value UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT DISTINCT country_code AS __text, country_code AS __value FROM europe_jobs ORDER BY country_code)

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Vacancies FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Vacancies FROM europe_jobs e WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT jt.technology) AS Technologies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT jt.technology) AS Technologies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND jt.requirement_type = 'required'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND jt.requirement_type = 'required'

targets.queryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'required' THEN e.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.id), 1) AS Coverage FROM europe_jobs e LEFT JOIN job_technologies jt ON jt.job_id = e.id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'required' THEN e.id END) / COUNT(DISTINCT e.id), 1) AS Coverage FROM europe_jobs e LEFT JOIN job_technologies jt ON jt.job_id = e.id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring})

targets.queryText: SELECT jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jt.technology ORDER BY Vacancies DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jt.technology ORDER BY Vacancies DESC LIMIT 20

targets.queryText: SELECT jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'required' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Required, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'preferred' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Preferred, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'alternative' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Alternative, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'mentioned' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Mentioned FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jt.technology ORDER BY Required DESC, Preferred DESC, Mentioned DESC LIMIT 15
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT jt.technology AS Technology, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'required' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Required, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'preferred' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Preferred, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'alternative' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Alternative, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN jt.requirement_type = 'mentioned' THEN jt.job_id END) AS Mentioned FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jt.technology ORDER BY Required DESC, Preferred DESC, Mentioned DESC LIMIT 15

targets.queryText: SELECT jt.category AS Category, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jt.category ORDER BY Vacancies DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT jt.category AS Category, COUNT(DISTINCT jt.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jt.category ORDER BY Vacancies DESC

targets.queryText: SELECT jc.concept AS Concept, COUNT(DISTINCT jc.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_concepts jc JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jc.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jc.concept ORDER BY Vacancies DESC LIMIT 15
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT jc.concept AS Concept, COUNT(DISTINCT jc.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM job_concepts jc JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jc.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) GROUP BY jc.concept ORDER BY Vacancies DESC LIMIT 15

targets.queryText: WITH required_tools AS (SELECT DISTINCT jt.job_id, jt.technology FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND jt.requirement_type = 'required') SELECT a.technology || ' + ' || b.technology AS Pair, COUNT(DISTINCT a.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM required_tools a JOIN required_tools b ON a.job_id = b.job_id AND a.technology < b.technology GROUP BY a.technology, b.technology ORDER BY Vacancies DESC, Pair LIMIT 20
targets.rawQueryText: WITH required_tools AS (SELECT DISTINCT jt.job_id, jt.technology FROM job_technologies jt JOIN europe_jobs e ON e.id = jt.job_id WHERE (${country:sqlstring} = '__all' OR e.country_code = ${country:sqlstring}) AND jt.requirement_type = 'required') SELECT a.technology || ' + ' || b.technology AS Pair, COUNT(DISTINCT a.job_id) AS Vacancies FROM required_tools a JOIN required_tools b ON a.job_id = b.job_id AND a.technology < b.technology GROUP BY a.technology, b.technology ORDER BY Vacancies DESC, Pair LIMIT 20
